name: Core + Conversation Architecture and Contract Freeze
principle: JARVIS is the system. AI models are replaceable brains used by JARVIS.

included: J1 milestone decomposition and acceptance gates
excluded: new production HSM or hardware-attestation claims
runtime implementation beyond J1.0 specification and freeze artifacts

securityRules: Conversation state cannot bypass identity, policy, risk, approval or tool-gateway enforcement.
Context assembly is owner-scoped, purpose-scoped, classification-aware and minimized before model disclosure.
NEVER_STORE content is not durably persisted by the conversation layer.
D5 content is never disclosed to an external model provider.
A tool proposal and tool execution remain separate states.
Sensitive continuation after approval is bound to the exact request, owner, session, device, security epoch and expiry required by Foundation v1.
Streaming partial output cannot commit a protected side effect.
Cancellation stops generation and future work without silently fabricating completion.
Retries cannot duplicate governed side effects.
Revocation, FREEZE, SAFE MODE and SHUTDOWN override conversation autonomy.
Conversation history cannot resurrect deleted or expired protected memory.
Provider failure must not cause privacy or authorization fallback.
Audit/event correlation must survive the complete turn lifecycle without protected plaintext leakage.
milestones: J1.4 Response generation and turn pipeline
J1.9 Operating modes and behavioral control
